source.citation: Königsberger, M., Pichler, B., Hellmich, C. (2014). Micromechanics of ITZ-Aggregate Interaction in Concrete Part I: Stress Concentration. Journal of the American Ceramic Society 97, 535-542.
source.location: Section V, p. 6, Appendix A and Table I, p. 7

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Section V, p. 6, Appendix A and Table I, p. 7, read on the page text
transcription.note: The 'typical concrete' of the article: quartz aggregates, a cement paste of w/c = 0.5 at 95 % hydration, and an ITZ whose Young modulus is 85 % of that of the paste with the same Poisson ratio. The same values drive the Echoes example ITZ_Pichler_sphnalyers_JACS2013.py. Only ratios of moduli enter a stress concentration.

E_aggregate.description: Young modulus of the quartz aggregates.

nu_aggregate.description: Poisson ratio of the quartz aggregates.

E_paste.description: Young modulus of the bulk cement paste.

nu_paste.description: Poisson ratio of the bulk cement paste.

E_itz.description: Young modulus of the ITZ, 85 % of that of the paste.

nu_itz.description: Poisson ratio of the ITZ, equal to that of the paste.

f_aggregate.description: Volume fraction of the aggregates in concrete.

Bvol.description: Volumetric part of the aggregate stress concentration tensor, Eq. (4).

Bdev.description: Deviatoric part of the aggregate stress concentration tensor, Eq. (4).

traction_pole_tension.description: Radial traction at the poles of the aggregate per unit uniaxial tensile macrostress (an amplification of 16 %).

traction_equator_compression.description: Tensile radial traction at the equator of the aggregate per unit magnitude of uniaxial compressive macrostress (1.3 %).

itz_peak_tension.description: Largest principal ITZ stress per unit uniaxial tensile macrostress (an amplification of 20 %), reached about pi/8 off the poles.

itz_peak_compression.description: Largest principal (tensile) ITZ stress per unit magnitude of uniaxial compressive macrostress (27 %), reached about pi/6 off the equator.
